description: This PHP file appears to be part of the TestLink open source testing management project. It contains code initializing a testing environment, creating a Testplan Manager object, and executing multiple calls to retrieve linked test case versions with various filters and options. The file outputs the results and debug information about linked test cases for specific test plans.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class representing a test plan manager responsible for retrieving linked test case versions.

methods.name: get_linked_tcversions
methods.description: Retrieves linked test case versions for a specific test plan, with optional filtering and options for the query.
